correctness.rationale: The six-form basis follows from valuations at infinity; exact Cartier block coefficients were reconstructed from the standard 1/7-semilinear identity. The twisted cyclic block contributes 2 exactly when P is nonzero, and the 2x2 self-block contributes 2, 1, or 0 by aE and W. Symbolic coefficients, discriminant nonvanishing on the parametrized rank-one cusps, algebraically complete rank-zero/rank-one case analysis, and independent F7/F49 direct Cartier iteration all agree. No finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The entire geometric rank and a-number structure for a natural constant-shifted odd quintic degree-four Kummer family is determined. All five possible stable ranks arise, with rank-one fibers on two irreducible punctured cusps and rank-zero fibers on a separate punctured line; these dimensional and boundary descriptions are meaningful degeneracy phenomena beyond generic Cartier computations.
